topic: Edward Deci University of Rochester Puzzle Cube Experiment: How Piece-Rate Cash Rewards Undermine Intrinsic Motivation and Dampen Striatal Valuation (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Follow-up MRI brain-scanning replication showing that once performance pay stops, spontaneous reward activity in the nucleus accumbens and striatum drops below unpaid peers during solitary play.

clips.environment: a sunlit pastel university lab room with a maple table holding seven carved wooden puzzle blocks, pastel magazines, and a wide observation mirror window
